product_overview: A single-page portfolio site that lets visitors get in touch through a contact form and personalize their viewing experience with language and theme controls. The app focuses on simple interactions from the main landing page.
core_goals: Send a message through the contact form
Switch the site language between English and Arabic
Toggle between light and dark theme modes

features.name: Contact Form Submission
features.description: Allow visitors to send a message from the main page using the contact form.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in name input field -> Fill in email input field -> Fill in message input field -> Submit the contact form -> See success message

features.name: Language Switch
features.description: Allow visitors to change the site language between English and Arabic from the main page.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle the language setting -> See the site language change

features.name: Theme Switch
features.description: Allow visitors to switch the site appearance between light and dark modes from the main page.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle the theme setting -> See the theme appearance change

features.name: Contact Form Submission
features.description: User can submit a contact form using Web3Forms
user_interactions: Click Send Message button to submit

features.name: Theme Switch
features.description: Toggle between light and dark themes
